comment: Blocked: needs a general Lua runtime in the port (js/nhlua.js load_lua runs only translated level programs). Debug-mode #wizloadlua ../home/.nethackrc runs des.corridor calls from the rc file; in C this runs sp_lev.c lspo_corridor, create_corridor and search_door lines no installed Lua reaches (blind review c blocks 324, 325, 330). See recipes/nhlua.c/rc-file-run-as-lua.

segments.nethackrc:
--[[
OPTIONS=name:Corrido,role:Valkyrie,race:human,gender:female,align:neutral
OPTIONS=!legacy,!tutorial,!splash_screen,pettype:none,!autopickup
OPTIONS=playmode:debug
]]
